title: Generational Triplets
approach: a+c = 2b with a^b^c = 0 forces b = a^c = 2*(a&c), so a&c has no two adjacent set bits and a,c merely split the bits of 2*(a&c); with n up to 1e18 the valid c are counted bit by bit against n.

techniques.label: bit-manipulation
techniques.why: the whole characterisation is about adjacent set bits

techniques.label: digit-dp
techniques.why: counting bit by bit against the bound n

techniques.label: combinatorics
techniques.why: splitting bits between a and c

verified: characterisation matched an O(n^2) triple count for n = 3, 10, 15, 40, 100, 257
